en.title: Revive Us Again
en.author: William P. Mackay
stanzas:
[G]We praise Thee, O God!
For the Son of Thy love,
For Jesus who died,
[C]And is now gone a[D]bove.

We praise Thee, O God!
For Thy Spirit of light,
Who hath shown us our Savior,
And scattered our night.

All glory and praise
To the Lamb that was slain,
Who hath borne all our sins,
And hath cleansed every stain.

All glory and praise
To the God of all grace,
Who hast bought us, and sought us,
And guided our ways.
en.chorus:
[G]Halle[C]lu[G]jah! Thine the glory.
Halle[C]lu[G]jah! A[D]men.
Halle[C]lu[G]jah! Thine the glory.
Re[C]vive [G]us [D7]a[G]gain.

notes: Text: Cyber Hymnal, five stanzas; Timeless Truths agrees except 'Who hast brought us, and sought us' in st. 4, where the common hymnal reading is 'bought'. Meter is disputed on hymnary: the text page lists both '11.11 with refrain' and '6.6.6.6.8.6.8.6', and the tune page lists the latter; '11.11 with refrain' is the one that matches the actual syllable counts, and the four short printed lines are those two long lines broken. Tune usually credited to John J. Husband (1815) but hymnary notes the resemblance to his ST. STEPHEN'S is only two bars. Common printed key is G, so no transposition; chart derived note-by-note from the Cyber Hymnal MIDI (mid/r/e/v/i/revive_us_again.mid), whose 50 melody onsets align exactly with the 49 syllables of stanza and refrain.
